findings.title: AGENTS.md does not reference the audit-pack / full-domain workflow
evidence: AGENTS.md has no repo-deep-dive / tools/full_domain.py reference
Audits land under docs/audits/repo-deep-dive/ but are not linked from AGENTS.md
docs/RELEASE_GATE.md is the only entry point to prior audit runs
findings.impact: An automating agent may re-derive or duplicate audit work instead of consuming the published runs.
findings.recommendation: Add a short 'audits' pointer in AGENTS.md to docs/audits and the evidence doctrine.

report: Agent readiness: AGENTS.md binding rules, deterministic command order, and scripts/generate-review-prompt.py exist. Residual: AGENTS.md does not mention the external audit pack / full-domain runner, so a fresh agent has no pointer to the audit-evidence workflow.
